core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Transition metal transport and homeostasis with iron and heme uptake
rationale: All members concern cellular handling of iron, copper, manganese, zinc, cobalt or cadmium (transport, homeostasis, detoxification, inherited iron disorders); unlike the zinc-centred (C2, C4) and response-centred (C3) neighbours it carries iron import, transferrin cycling and heme scavenging/assimilation, and unlike C1 it spans copper and manganese.

core: APOBEC cytidine deamination and retroviral restriction
name: Early HIV-1 replication and APOBEC cytidine deaminase restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and frameshifting together with APOBEC3G/cytidine-deaminase editing and restriction; the early replication steps separate it from C1-C3 and the APOBEC editing arm separates it from the integration-focused C4.

qualifier: BH3-only activation and cytochrome c release
name: p53-driven apoptosis via BH3-only proteins and cytochrome c release
rationale: All members are steps of p53-induced mitochondrial apoptosis, from TP53 transcription of death genes to PUMA/NOXA BH3-only action and cytochrome c release; the BH3-only/mitochondrial arm separates it from C2 and C4, and the TP53 transcriptional arm from C3.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, oligopeptides and urate
name: Solute carrier transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated plasma membrane transport of amino acids, peptides, urate, organic anions and glucose plus their inherited renal transport defects; neutral amino acid and proton-coupled peptide transport distinguish it from the organic cation (C1, C3), cationic amino acid (C2) and hexose (C4) neighbours.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription control including termination and R-loops
rationale: Most members regulate RNA polymerase II initiation, elongation or termination (with transcription-linked BTM modules); termination control, R-loop processing and chromatin-occupancy regulation distinguish it from the elongation-complex neighbour C3 and the heterogeneous chromatin/RNA-processing neighbours C1, C2 and C4.

core: Ubiquitin-like modifier control of NF-kappaB signalling
name: NF-kappaB regulation by K63 deubiquitination and SUMOylation
rationale: Members regulate NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity through K63 ubiquitin removal, ubiquitin activation and SUMOylation; the NF-kappaB regulatory focus separates it from the DUB-family neighbours C1, C2 and C4, and the K63 deubiquitination arm from the TNFR1-centred C3.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chain assembly in misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members are non-K48 ubiquitin chain types (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free chains) built by E3 ligases together with misfolded-protein quality control, ERAD and Josephin DUBs; the quality-control arm separates it from C1-C3 and the chain-type arm from the ERAD/reticulophagy neighbour C4.

core: Hepatic organic anion transport and glucuronidation
name: Bilirubin and drug glucuronidation with hepatic organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover SLCO uptake, UGT glucuronidation and ABCC2 export of bilirubin (heme degradation, hyperbilirubinemias) and drugs (ADME); bilirubin/heme catabolism distinguishes it from C3 and C4, and glucuronidation-linked drug ADME from the xenobiotic-export neighbours C1 and C2.

core: Antimicrobial killing of bacteria and fungi
name: Antimicrobial cytolysis and metal sequestration against bacteria and fungi
rationale: All members describe host killing or restraint of microbes (Gram-positive bacteria, yeast/fungi, cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity); direct antimicrobial effector mechanisms separate it from the degranulation (C1), respiratory-burst (C3) and mucosal agglutination (C2, C4) neighbours.

core: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
name: LXR nuclear receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor transcription, its SUMOylation, and LXR-driven lipogenesis, lipolysis, gluconeogenesis and VLDL remodelling genes; nuclear-receptor transcriptional control distinguishes it from the triglyceride/adipose-physiology neighbours C1, C3 and C4 and LXR from the PPARA/clock neighbour C2.

name: Antifungal C-type lectin signalling with Th17 and IL-1 family cytokines
rationale: Members link fungal/yeast and lectin sensing (Dectin-1, Dectin-2, DC-SIGN) to IL-17/Th17, IL-12/23 and IL-1 family (IL-18, IL-36, IL-37, IL-38) cytokine output; the lectin arm separates it from C1, the IL-17 and IL-1 family arms from C2 and C3, and IL-18/IL-1 family signalling from the IL-10/12/23 receptor neighbour C4.

name: Hypersensitivity and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity with endopeptidase regulation
rationale: Most members are antigen-driven immune effector responses (ADCC, type II and IV hypersensitivity, acute inflammatory response to antigen), with positive/negative endopeptidase regulation being exactly what C1-C3 lack, and the absence of complement cascade members separating it from C4.

name: GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members describe GPCR/forskolin-stimulated cAMP production and PKA activation (including PKA restraint of calcium-dependent exocytosis); cAMP synthesis and GPCR coupling distinguish it from the CREB/cAMP-degradation neighbours C1, C2 and C4, and adenylate cyclase activation from the inhibitory neighbour C3.

core: Cellular response to heavy metal ions
name: Metallothionein-linked responses to diverse heavy metal ions
rationale: Members are responses to copper, zinc, manganese, cobalt, lead, mercury, iron and selenium with MTF1/metallothionein induction; the breadth of metals distinguishes it from the cadmium-centred C2 and C3, metal (not organic xenobiotic) responses from C1, and the absence of HMOX1/oxidative regulation from C4.

qualifier: T follicular helper help and B cell homeostasis
name: Germinal center B cell and T follicular helper responses
rationale: Members cover germinal center formation, GC B cell differentiation, Tfh differentiation with ICOS co-stimulation, memory B cells and restraint of B cell proliferation and apoptosis; the GC/Tfh and homeostatic regulation arms distinguish it from the plasma-cell/generic B cell neighbours C1, C3 and C4, and the memory B cell signature from C2.

name: Golgi architecture remodelling and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and vesicle budding plus endosomal membrane tubulation; organelle architecture distinguishes it from the cargo-traffic neighbours C1, C3 and C4, and tubulation from the COPI-traffic neighbour C2.

qualifier: Cajal body trafficking of telomerase RNA
name: Telomerase holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension
rationale: Members describe telomerase RNA folding, holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and recruitment to telomeres for extension; the telomerase/Cajal body axis distinguishes it from telomere protection and C-strand synthesis neighbours (C1, C2, C4) and from the senescence/lifespan neighbour C3.

name: B cell differentiation toward plasma and memory cells
rationale: Members are B cell signatures and processes of activation and differentiation into plasma cells (immunoglobulin modules), memory cells and germinal center B cells; plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin modules distinguish it from C3 and C4, and differentiation (rather than proliferation/BCR signalling) from C1 and C2.

name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation with MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members cover NK cell signatures, activating receptors and positive/negative control of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, including MHC class Ib antigen presentation; activating-receptor and MHC class Ib members distinguish it from the KIR/granzyme neighbours C1-C3 and the NK/T activation neighbour C4.

core: Innate antimicrobial defence at the host-pathogen interface
name: Complement and antimicrobial peptide defence at host-pathogen interface
rationale: Members span complement activation and regulation, defensins and neutrophil granule antimicrobials, and bacterial manipulation of host defences (Mtb, Listeria); the complement cascade distinguishes it from its closest neighbour C2, and antimicrobial/pathogen members from the hypersensitivity (C1) and neutrophil-activation (C3, C4) neighbours.

core: DNA repair- and replication-coupled nucleosome remodelling
name: DNA repair-coupled nucleosome remodelling with ADP-ribosylation control
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly, disassembly and remodelling during DNA repair and replication with chromatin protein recruitment and de-ADP-ribosylation; repair-coupled remodelling distinguishes it from the centromeric (C1) and acetylation (C4) neighbours, and nucleosome remodelling from the double-strand-break and PARylation neighbours C2 and C3.

qualifier: COPI transport and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
name: COPI Golgi traffic and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, tethering and retrograde/intra-Golgi traffic, Golgi organization, and Rab/ARF GTPase cycling and prenylation; Rab GTPase regulation separates it from the TGN-endolysosomal neighbours C1-C3, and COPI traffic from the GTPase-focused neighbour C4.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 production with cGAS-STING activation
rationale: Members regulate dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 chemokine output, with cGAMP import and cGAS-STING activation; the cGAS-STING arm distinguishes it from the IL-12/Th1 (C1) and macrophage-chemokine (C2) neighbours, DC/CCL5 output from the cGAS-inhibition/IFN-beta neighbour C4, and the whole set from the TLR7-9 neighbour C3.

core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
name: Double-strand break sensing and end-joining versus recombination choice
rationale: All members describe DSB sensing, ATM recruitment, classical/alternative NHEJ and regulation of NHEJ versus homologous recombination; the NHEJ/HR balance distinguishes it from the BRCA-defect (C1), resection/MMEJ (C3) and ADP-ribosylation/chromatin (C2, C4) neighbours.

qualifier: retinol transport and retinoic acid synthesis
name: Vitamin A metabolism, transport and retinoic acid synthesis
rationale: Members concern retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism (as terpenoids) and retinoid transport disease such as STRA6 loss; STRA6/retinoid transport disease distinguishes it from the vitamin D/CYP26 (C1, C3) and retinoic acid response (C4) neighbours, and retinoic acid synthesis from the visual retinoid cycle neighbour C2.
